svg.title: SecondChance layered AWS architecture
svg.desc: Professional layered architecture showing public edge, API ingress, private orchestration, a mandatory MCP Gateway policy layer, governed RAG and data services, and cross-cutting operations.
svg.text: Layered serverless architecture · every agent tool call is governed before it can reach RAG, data or AI services
AWS VPC · PRIVATE SUBNETS · TWO AVAILABILITY ZONES · VPC ENDPOINTS · NO NAT GATEWAY
Run · conversation · tenant scopes · TTL · tenant-isolated in Aurora
03 · MCP GATEWAY — MANDATORY AGENT TOOL BOUNDARY
No agent reaches downstream services directly
infrastructure as code · immutable images · keyless delivery
